title: Fast Confirmation Rule #7, May 12, 2026
summary: Lodestar: FCR implementation deployed on 5+ nodes for over a week; PR under team review, expected merge within a week Grandine: Two pre-existing bugs identified post-spec-merge — relative epoch helper rejecting lookups and unrealized justified checkpoints on fork chains; fix expected by Friday Nimbus shipped FCR enabled by default, then disabled it after discovering Nethermind safe-head incompatibility with engine AP

decisions.title: FCR spec will be made gGLOSSS-compatible via fork choice abstraction layer refactor; if infeasible, spec will be made fork-aware instead
